'''Kiara Schmong''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] that sold weapons to many factions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]; one of her favorite clients was the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] of [[Ennix Devian]].

She was the aide to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naren Bluuis]] but fled after she tried to lead a group of New Republic agents into an ambush to prevent them from finding an ancient [[Kashi Mer talisman|relic]].<ref name="AJ6">{{JournalCite|6|Relic (article)}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kiara Schmong first appeared in the [[1995]] article "[[Relic (article)|Relic]]" published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|''Adventure Journal'' #6]]. Originally named simply as Kiara,<ref name="AJ6" /> she was given the surname "Schmong" in the [[2013]] article "[[The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire]]."<ref name="Imperial Warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> According to one of the article's authors, [[Abel G. Peña]], Kiara had been given the surname to imply she was a descendant of [[Ruggle Schmong/Legends|Ruggle Schmong]], explaining her knowledge of ion technology.<ref>{{JCFCite|url=posts/52223136|board=Literature|thread=The Official StarWars.com Blog Thread - That's right, I went there|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2015-03-13|quote=Thanks, Protectorate. :) The last name given to the "Counterstrike" character Kiara Schmong was also meant to indicate she was a descendent of Ruggle Schmong, creator of the Malevolence -- hence explaining her focus on ion technology in the SWAJ.|archivedate=20150331093724}}</ref>
